dialogue.origin: （こんばんは。時間になりましたら始めますので宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. We will begin at the scheduled time. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: (よろしくお願いします)
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。まずは年齢・性別、話したい事を教えてください。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm your counselor. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to talk about?

dialogue.origin: 30歳 女仕事をやめようか悩んでます
dialogue.content: I'm a 30-year-old woman, and I'm struggling with whether or not to quit my job.

dialogue.origin: 仕事を辞めたいという事ですね。
dialogue.content: So, you're thinking about quitting your job.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 間違えました。辞めようかですね。
dialogue.content: My mistake. You're wondering whether you should quit.

dialogue.origin: やめたい気持ちはあります
dialogue.content: I do have the desire to quit.

dialogue.origin: なぜ仕事を辞めたいのか何かありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there any particular reason you want to quit your job?

dialogue.origin: 仕事がきついからです
dialogue.content: Because the work is tough.

dialogue.origin: 本当はやめたくはないのですかね、きつくなければ、他に辞めたい理由はありますか？
dialogue.content: I wonder, do you not actually want to quit? If it weren't so demanding, are there any other reasons you'd want to leave?

dialogue.origin: きつくないなら、辞めなくてもいいかなあと思います
dialogue.content: If it weren't so tough, I think I'd be okay with not quitting.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・きつくなければ辞めなくてもいいとの事ですね。
dialogue.content: I see... so if it weren't tough, you would be okay with not quitting.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そう思われる理由はありますか？どの位、今はつらいのですか？
dialogue.content: Is there a reason you feel that way? How difficult is it for you right now?

dialogue.origin: 定時で帰れる、土日も休みと思って転職したのに、残業あるし、土日の仕事もあるし…
dialogue.content: I changed jobs thinking I could leave on time and have weekends off, but there's overtime and work on the weekends...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、それは辛いですよね。
dialogue.content: I see, that must be very difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 仕事はどのくらい頑張って来られてきたんですか？
dialogue.content: How long have you been hanging in there at this job?

dialogue.origin: 今年で2年目です
dialogue.content: This is my second year.

dialogue.origin: そんなんですね、２年間、辛くても頑張って来られたのに、休みもなく、定時にもあがれないんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So even though you've worked hard for two years despite the difficulty, you don't get days off and can't leave on time.

dialogue.origin: （誤字そう）
dialogue.content: (That was a typo.)

dialogue.origin: 休みないことはないですけど…想像と違ったって感じです
dialogue.content: It's not that I don't get any days off at all... it's just that it's different from what I imagined.

dialogue.origin: どんなふうに、想像と違いましたか？
dialogue.content: In what way was it different from what you imagined?

dialogue.origin: さっき話した、定時で帰れて土日休みだと思ってたってことです
dialogue.content: It's what I mentioned earlier: that I thought I could leave on time and have weekends off.

dialogue.origin: はい。そうゆうことですね。失礼いたしました。
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand. That's what you meant. My apologies.

dialogue.origin: 例えば、土日休みならどうですかね？
dialogue.content: For example, what if you had weekends off?

dialogue.origin: 何を答えればいいですか？
dialogue.content: How am I supposed to answer that?

dialogue.origin: 定時で帰れて、土日休みなら辞めなくてもいいとの事ですねかね？
dialogue.content: So, if you could leave on time and have weekends off, you would be okay with not quitting, is that right?

dialogue.origin: まぁそうですかね。
dialogue.content: Well, I suppose so.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.origin: もう次の仕事は探されてますのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Have you already started looking for your next job?

dialogue.origin: まだです
dialogue.content: Not yet.

dialogue.origin: まだ今の仕事を本当はやめたくはないのですかね？
dialogue.content: So perhaps you don't actually want to quit your current job yet?

dialogue.origin: 安定はしてるので、やめない方がいいのかなとは思います
dialogue.content: It's stable, so I'm inclined to think it might be better not to quit.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、ありがとうございます。２年間頑張って来られ。この先もやめたくはないけども定時で帰れて、土日休みなら問題ないとの事ですね。
dialogue.content: I see, thank you. You've worked hard for two years. Going forward, you don't want to quit, and if you could just leave on time and have weekends off, there wouldn't be a problem, is that correct?

dialogue.origin: う―んやめたくないんですかね
dialogue.content: Hmm... I wonder if I don't actually want to quit.

dialogue.origin: 残業がなく、毎日、定時で帰れるなら、辞めなくてもいいかと思います。
dialogue.content: If there were no overtime and you could leave on time every day, I think it would be fine not to quit.

dialogue.origin: でも、そうするにはどうしたらいいんですか？
dialogue.content: But how can I make that happen?

dialogue.origin: 会社の上司に相談してみたり。同じ考えをもっている人と話してみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How about talking to your supervisor? You could also try speaking with colleagues who feel the same way.

dialogue.origin: 少なくとも何かは変わると思います。
dialogue.content: I think at least something would change.

dialogue.origin: 上司はそれが普通っていうし。みんな、前はもっと忙しかったって言います
dialogue.content: My boss says it's normal. Everyone says it used to be even busier.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか、あなたは普通だと思っていない。人それぞれ価値観が違いますからね。
dialogue.content: Is that so? But you don't think it's normal. Everyone has different values, after all.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: はい。また何かございましたら相談に来てください。この話しも途中ですから。
dialogue.content: Yes. Please feel free to come back and talk again if anything else comes up. This discussion isn't over, after all.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございます、途中でおかしくなりました、ありがとうございます。お疲れ様でした。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you. Things got a bit strange in the middle. Thank you again. That was a good session.)

dialogue.origin: (こちらこそありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした。)
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well. It was a pleasure. You too.)

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

topic.sub: 仕事の辞め時と転職についての悩み
